steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Peel and chop {{ing:butternut-squash}} and {{ing:onion-medium}}. Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} in a tin.
Add {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Roast 35 minutes, until soft and caramelised.
Tip into a pan with {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Simmer 5 minutes.
Blend until smooth. Add {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Fry {{ing:fresh-sage}} leaves in a little oil until crisp. Float on top.

recipes.name: Garlic mushrooms on toast
recipes.method_note: A hot, uncrowded pan browns mushrooms. A crowded one stews them.

steps.instruction: Put a large frying pan on a high heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Slice {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Fry 6 minutes, until browned and the liquid has gone.
Add sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}} leaves. Fry 1 minute.
Squeeze in half of {{ing:lemon}}. Stir in chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Toast {{ing:sourdough}}. Pile the mushrooms on top.
Cut cooked {{ing:beetroot}} into wedges.
Slice {{ing:apple-medium}} thinly.
Toast {{ing:walnuts}} in a dry pan 3 minutes, until fragrant.
Toss {{ing:rocket}}, the beetroot and apple on plates.
Whisk {{ing:olive-oil}} with {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}. Spoon over. Scatter the walnuts.
Separate the leaves of {{ing:chicory}}. Lay on plates.
Slice {{ing:pear}} thinly. Tuck between the leaves.
Crumble over {{ing:stilton}}. Scatter {{ing:walnuts}}.
Whisk {{ing:honey}}, {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}.
Spoon over the salad.

recipes.name: Smoked mackerel with beetroot and horseradish

steps.instruction: Flake {{ing:smoked-mackerel}} into large pieces. Take off the skin.
Slice {{ing:beetroot}}. Lay on plates with the fish.
Stir {{ing:horseradish-sauce}} into {{ing:creme-fraiche}}.
Spoon on beside the fish.
Top with {{ing:watercress}}. Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Scallops with cauliflower purée
recipes.method_note: Leave the scallops alone while they sear, so a crust forms.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:cauliflower-head}} into small florets. Simmer in {{ing:milk-whole}} 12 minutes, until soft.
Drain, keeping a little milk. Blend with half of {{ing:butter-unsalted}} until silky.
Pat {{ing:scallops}} dry with kitchen paper.
Put a frying pan on a high heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Sear the scallops 90 seconds a side, until golden. Add the rest of the butter.
Spoon purée onto plates. Top with scallops. Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Grate {{ing:apple-medium}}. Chop {{ing:fresh-sage}}. Mix into {{ing:sausagemeat}}.
Cut {{ing:puff-pastry}} in half lengthways.
Lay a sausage of the meat along each strip. Roll the pastry over. Seal with a fork.
Brush with beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}. Sprinkle with {{ing:fennel-seeds}}. Cut into 12.
Bake 25 minutes, until puffed and golden.

recipes.name: Chicken livers with sherry on toast

steps.instruction: Trim {{ing:chicken-livers}} of any sinew.
Put a frying pan on a high heat. Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}}.
Chop {{ing:shallot}}. Fry 2 minutes.
Add the livers and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Fry 3 minutes, until browned but pink inside.
Add {{ing:sherry}}. Bubble 1 minute.
Toast {{ing:sourdough}}. Pile the livers and juices on top.

recipes.name: Pork chops with cider and apples

steps.instruction: Put a large frying pan on a medium-high heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Brown {{ing:pork-chops}} 4 minutes each side. Lift onto a plate.
Slice {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:apple-medium}}. Fry 6 minutes, until golden.
Add {{ing:cider-dry}} and {{ing:fresh-sage}}. Bubble 3 minutes.
Return the chops. Simmer 6 minutes, until cooked through.
Stir in {{ing:creme-fraiche}} and {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}}.

recipes.name: Beef and red wine casserole
recipes.method_note: Browning in batches stops the pan cooling and the meat stewing grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C. Cut {{ing:beef-braising}} into chunks. Toss in {{ing:flour-plain}}.
Brown the beef in {{ing:olive-oil}} in a casserole, in batches. Lift out.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}, {{ing:wine-red}}, {{ing:stock-cube}} crumbled in 300 ml water, {{ing:bay-leaf}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Return the beef. Cover.
Cook in the oven 2 hours 30 minutes, until the beef falls apart.
Heat the oven to 200C. Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a large pan.
Slice {{ing:leek}} and {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Fry 8 minutes.
Cut {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} into chunks. Add and fry 5 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Add {{ing:stock-chicken}} slowly, stirring until thick.
Stir in {{ing:creme-fraiche}}. Tip into a pie dish.
Cover with {{ing:puff-pastry}}. Brush with beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Bake 30 minutes, until puffed and golden.

recipes.name: Lamb shanks with plums and star anise

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C.
Brown {{ing:lamb-shank}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} in a casserole. Lift out.
Slice {{ing:red-onion}}. Fry 8 minutes.
Halve and stone {{ing:plums}}. Add with {{ing:star-anise}}, {{ing:wine-red}} and {{ing:honey}}.
Crumble in {{ing:stock-cube}} with 300 ml water. Return the lamb.
Cover. Cook 2 hours 30 minutes, until the meat falls off the bone.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Mix {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}, chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}, the zest of {{ing:lemon}} and 1 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Brush {{ing:cod-fillet}} with {{ing:mustard-dijon}}. Press the crumbs on top.
Bake 12 minutes, until the fish flakes.
Warm drained {{ing:lentils-tinned}} in the rest of the oil with sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Stir in {{ing:spinach}} until wilted. Add the lemon juice. Serve under the fish.
Heat the oven to 200C. Slice {{ing:potato-medium}} thinly. Boil 5 minutes. Drain.
Simmer {{ing:haddock-smoked}} in {{ing:milk-whole}} 5 minutes. Lift out the fish. Keep the milk.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a pan. Slice {{ing:leek}}. Fry 6 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Add the milk slowly, stirring until thick.
Flake in the fish. Tip into a dish. Top with the potatoes.
Scatter {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}. Bake 25 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Squash and king prawn red curry

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}} for the time on the packet.
Fry {{ing:thai-red-curry-paste}} in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} 1 minute.
Peel and dice half of {{ing:butternut-squash}}. Add with {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}.
Simmer 15 minutes, until the squash is soft.
Add {{ing:king-prawns-raw}}. Cook 3 minutes, until pink.
Stir in {{ing:spinach}}, {{ing:fish-sauce}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Soak {{ing:shiitake-dried}} in 200 ml boiling water 20 minutes. Chop. Add the water to {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a wide pan. Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes.
Slice {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Fry with the shiitake 5 minutes.
Add {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}}. Stir 1 minute. Add {{ing:wine-white}}.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, about 18 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:fresh-thyme}} leaves and grated {{ing:parmesan}}.

swaps.text: A vegetarian hard cheese: most parmesan is made with animal rennet

recipes.name: Roast squash, sage and goats cheese pasta

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Peel and dice half of {{ing:butternut-squash}}. Toss with 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Roast 30 minutes, until soft and browned.
Cook {{ing:penne-dry}} for the time on the packet. Keep a mug of water.
Fry {{ing:fresh-sage}} in the rest of the oil until crisp.
Toss the pasta, squash, sage and a splash of water. Top with {{ing:goats-cheese}} and {{ing:walnuts}}.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut {{ing:cauliflower-head}} into florets. Boil 5 minutes. Drain well.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}}. Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}} 1 minute.
Add {{ing:milk-whole}} slowly, stirring until thick and smooth.
Stir in two thirds of {{ing:cheddar-cheese}} and {{ing:mustard-dijon}}.
Pour over the cauliflower. Top with the rest of the cheese and {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}.
Bake 25 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
Heat the oven to 200C. Peel {{ing:potato-large}}. Boil 20 minutes. Mash with 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}} in the rest of the oil 8 minutes.
Chop {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Fry 6 minutes.
Add drained {{ing:lentils-tinned}}, {tomato-purée}, {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:stock-vegetable}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Simmer 10 minutes, until thick. Tip into a dish.
Top with the mash. Bake 25 minutes, until golden on top.
Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes. Add {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:cumin-ground}}, {{ing:smoked-paprika}} and {{ing:chilli-powder}}.
Dice {{ing:pumpkin}}. Add and stir 2 minutes.
Add drained {{ing:black-beans-tinned}} and {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}.
Simmer 25 minutes, until the pumpkin is tender.
Squeeze in {{ing:lime}}. Scatter with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.
Heat the oven to 200C. Peel and cut {{ing:beetroot-raw}} and {{ing:red-onion}} into wedges.
Toss with 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}. Roast 40 minutes, until tender.
Simmer {{ing:lentils-green-dry}} in water 25 minutes, until tender. Drain.
Strip {{ing:kale}} from its stalks. Add to the tin for the last 5 minutes.
Whisk the rest of the oil, {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}} and {{ing:mustard-dijon}}.
Toss everything together. Scatter {{ing:walnuts}}.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut {{ing:butternut-squash}} into wedges, skin on. Take out the seeds.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:chilli-flakes}} and {{ing:salt}}.
Roast 40 minutes, turning once, until soft and charred at the edges.
Strip {{ing:kale}} from its stalks. Tear into pieces.
Put a wide pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Slice {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Fry 1 minute.
Add the kale and a splash of water. Stir 4 minutes, until tender. Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}.
Peel and dice {{ing:celeriac}} and {{ing:potato-medium}}.
Boil 20 minutes, until soft. Drain well.
Mash with {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and warm {{ing:milk-whole}}.
Grate in {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut {{ing:carrot-large}}, {{ing:parsnip}} and {{ing:red-onion}} into chunks.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Roast 40 minutes, turning once, until golden.
Slice {{ing:fennel-bulb}}, {{ing:apple-medium}} and {{ing:red-cabbage}} very thinly.
Whisk the juice of {{ing:lemon}}, {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}}.
Toss with the vegetables.

recipes.name: Apple and blackberry crumble
recipes.method_note: Made with spread, so it is vegan. Butter works too.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C.
Peel, core and slice {{ing:apple-cooking}}. Toss with {{ing:blackberries}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Tip into a baking dish.
Rub {{ing:dairy-free-spread}} into {{ing:flour-plain}} until like breadcrumbs. Stir in {{ing:sugar-demerara}}.
Scatter over the fruit.
Bake 35 minutes, until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Baked apples with maple and pecans
recipes.method_note: The scored line stops the skins bursting.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C.
Core {{ing:apple-cooking}}. Score a line round the middle of each.
Chop {{ing:pecans}}. Mix with {{ing:sultanas}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Stuff into the apples. Stand them in a dish.
Pour over {{ing:maple-syrup}}. Bake 40 minutes, until soft and puffing.

recipes.name: Plums roasted in port with coconut yoghurt

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Halve and stone {{ing:plums}}. Lay cut side up in a dish.
Pour over {{ing:port}}. Sprinkle {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}. Add {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}.
Roast 20 minutes, until soft and syrupy.
Serve warm with {{ing:coconut-yoghurt}}.
Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 23 cm tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}.
Bake 15 minutes with baking beans. Take them out.
Beat {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Stir in {{ing:ground-almonds}}. Spread in the pastry case.
Peel, halve and core {{ing:pear}}. Slice. Press into the almond filling.
Bake 35 minutes, until golden and set.
Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 20 cm tin.
Spread {{ing:golden-syrup}} over the base. Peel and slice {{ing:pear}}. Lay on top.
Beat {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} until fluffy.
Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}. Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}} and {{ing:ginger-ground}}.
Spread over the pears. Bake 40 minutes, until springy.
Turn out upside down while warm.
Heat the oven to 170C.
Slice {{ing:brioche}}. Spread with {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and {{ing:jam-strawberry}}.
Layer in a baking dish.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:milk-whole}}, {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Pour over. Leave 15 minutes to soak.
Bake 35 minutes, until set and golden.

swaps.text: Orange marmalade, for a bitter-sweet edge

steps.instruction: Peel, core and dice {{ing:apple-medium}}.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} in a pan.
Add the apples. Cook 8 minutes, until soft and caramel-coated. Cool.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} to soft peaks.
Layer apples and cream in glasses.
Crumble {{ing:ginger-nut-biscuits}} on top.
Heat the oven to 160C. Line a 20 cm square tin.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}}, {{ing:golden-syrup}}, {{ing:black-treacle}} and {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} together.
Mix {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:oats-rolled}} and {{ing:ginger-ground}} in a bowl.
Pour in the melted mix. Add {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:milk-whole}}. Stir well.
Pour into the tin. Bake 45 minutes, until firm.
Cool. Wrap and leave a day before cutting.
steps.note: It turns stickier as it sits.

steps.instruction: Pour {{ing:apple-juice}} into a pan.
Add {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:cloves}} and sliced {{ing:orange}}.
Warm 10 minutes, without boiling.
Ladle into mugs.
Crush {{ing:blackberries}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Leave 10 minutes.
Sieve out the seeds.
Stir in {{ing:apple-juice}}.
Pour over ice. Top up with {{ing:sparkling-water}}.
Pour {{ing:cider-dry}} into a pan.
Slice {{ing:pear}}. Add with {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:star-anise}} and {{ing:honey}}.
Warm 10 minutes, without boiling.
Serve warm in mugs.
Crush {{ing:blackberries}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Add {{ing:spirit-40}} and the juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Strain over crushed ice in 4 glasses.
